name: owned-module-boundaries
goal: Preserve helper definitions, callable contracts and dependency direction in owner-local modules

evidence: Audit found mismatched private filenames and core forwarding imports into workflows. Runtime contracts must follow actual owner layers without losing callable exports or unit identities.

The migration ledger checked definitions and colocation but omitted split utility names and runtime entry contracts. Extend the frozen ledger and existing project detection tests with native cold-import checks.
